name: mcp-cli-adapter
stderr:
Usage: mcpa [options] [command]

Convert any MCP server into a CLI

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  --server <path|url>            MCP server path or URL
  --transport <type>             Transport: stdio | http | sse (default:
                                 auto-detect)
  --auth-env <KEY>               Env var containing auth token
  --no-cache                     Skip schema cache
  --output <format>              Output: json | table | pretty
  --timeout <ms>                 Connection timeout in ms (default: "30000")
  --verbose                      Show MCP protocol debug messages
  --profile <name>               Use a named server profile from config
  --config <path>                Path to config file
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]                 Interactive setup wizard — writes
                                 .mcp-cli.json
  profiles                       List available server profiles from config
  doctor                         Diagnose config, auth, connection, and
                                 discovery issues
  audit                          Audit log commands
  completions [options] [shell]  Generate shell completion script (bash, zsh,
                                 or fish)
  cache-clear|cache clear        Clear the schema cache
  list                           List all tools, resources, and prompts on the
                                 server
  inspect <tool>                 Show full schema for a specific tool
  run <tool>                     Execute a tool directly with --key value or
                                 --key=value pairs
  help [command]                 display help for command
